messages:
ana: quick check  I updated Prompt Sets > Eval Runs: moved approve FAB into toolbar, added per-user compact/comfortable toggle, and put a tiny quality chip in the row. figma: https://figma.com/file/new
kevin: Looks cleaner. Quick copy nit: label the toggle 'Compact' / 'Comfortable' rather than 'Dense' / 'Spacious'.
lee: Agree. Also for the toolbar action use 'Approve selected' (no 'bulk'). Tooltip: 'Approve selected eval runs and lock scorecards'.
sophie: Accessibility: increase checkbox hit target to 24px, add aria-live region for selection count, and ensure the quality chip has hidden SR text like 'Quality score: 82'.
a11y-bot: a11y rec: announce selections with polite aria-live e.g. '3 runs selected'. When modal opens for approval include aria-describedby referencing the consequence paragraph: 'Only project admins can unapprove; see docs'. Provide keyboard shortcut scoping so global shortcuts don't fire when focus in textareas.
nana: (typo) meant ana: I'll make those changes. One more: chevron for expand is 20pxincrease to 40px touch target and add aria-label 'Toggle diff preview'.
kevin: Microcopy for confirmation modal: replace 'Are you sure?' with 'Approve 3 runs? This will lock these scorecards and prevent edits unless unapproved by a project admin.' Add link to docs in modal.
lee: Visual: in comfortable mode add subtle dividers; in compact mode remove dividers and use hover tint. Also ensure focus ring is clearly visible on dark/high-contrast themes.
sophie: I'll run a keyboard-only pass and paste step-by-step SR narration examples here for the handoff to eng after ana updates.
ana: (ana) thanks, will update prototype and post new link by EOD :thumbsup:
